display_name: Dry scrub tree - wind bent juniper
origin: base centre of trunk on the ground (z=0); trunk/roots buried up to ~0.5 m; +Z up

collision.notes: UCX_* trunk capsule-like convex hulls (<=32 verts); one hull per stem on multi-stem trees (birch_b, olive_c), two stacked hulls on curved palm trunks; canopy/foliage has NO collision. UE: Collision Complexity = Use Simple As Complex

far_card.use: swap in beyond ~120-200 m (or as impostor); alpha-masked (clip ~0.33), two-sided, 2 crossed quads; power-of-two texture atlas = [view along Y | view along X], each half maps to one quad (non-uniform texel aspect, UVs fill 0-1)

wind.B: baked ambient occlusion (ray cast, 1 = open sky)
wind.hint: WPO: sway = R^2 * low-freq wind; flutter = G * high-freq noise; multiply base colour by lerp(0.35,1,B)

lod.nanite: recommended (all opaque geometry, no alpha cards inside the mesh)
lod.notes: LOD0 = Nanite mesh; <id>_Far = distance impostor / HLOD card

uv: UVMap: trunk/branch U wraps once per ring, V = 0.25-0.5 per metre of length (tiling bark); leaf cards map 0-1 per card (planar)

quality.boundary_edges_note: open edges belong to single-sided leaf/needle cards by design
